semantics.samples: Raw straight RGBA codes, including alpha-zero hidden RGB and hidden/off-artboard stored tiles. Eight->sixteen exact x257; sixteen->eight nearest integer (code+128)/257 without dither, so lower precision can change RGB/alpha.
semantics.metadata: All current pixel/group/fill/exposure/HSL/typed adjustment kinds, all five style colors/endpoints. Normalized floating settings, IDs/tree/clipping/positions/DPI/frame/frozen references/ICC stay unchanged. Exhaustive kind/style destructuring forces future types to define conversion.
semantics.masks: Layer/group/current/previous mask u16 layouts, anchors, enabled flags, samples and tile versions stay exact. Independent of active selection.
semantics.history: One atomic history and exact source/archive/AI-turn undo. Same-depth no-op before locks/work preserves current layer/revision/dirty/history.
semantics.schema: New document and conversion share a numeric enum permitting only integer8/16 in actual parsing and schemas. Unknown fields/floats/strings/unsupported depth reject; strict typed return and exact AI replacement approval.
semantics.resources: Target frame/frozen references/logical pixel+mask totals checked before conversion; per-tile/row cancellation and pooled scratch/output. Pressure failure and actual conversion cancellation preserve original source/depth/versions and release transient reservations.
semantics.locks: Pixel/transparency/all including ancestor/hidden locks reject; position-only allowed.

remaining: 32-bit/HDR, other color models and all remaining Photoshop features, final feature-by-feature AI audit, continuous performance/live-model/hardware/platform/release gates remain independent and open.
